title: Precompile equation motion sampling
summary: Equation motion sampling now has a compiled sampler that pre-indexes motif timelines and is used by the player and public animation session.

sourceRefs.summary: Adds createEquationMotionSampler and keeps sampleEquationMotion as a one-shot wrapper.
Routes equation playback through a compiled sampler instead of rebuilding sampling context per frame.
Uses a compiled sampler for public session getFrame and returned setProgress frames.
Covers construction-time beat validation and independent motif frame samples from the compiled sampler.

verificationRecords.scope: App, node, and test TypeScript projects.
Production build and typecheck; Vite large chunk warning remains.
